title: Bind UI semantics, preferences and the persistent banner dock through ports
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md and the exact referenced imported design sections before editing. RULES-SPEC-v1.md is canonical for production mechanics: six-node Repair/Sabotage tracks, one-person crew votes, Route/Gate operations, deterministic powers and silent spectators. SCREEN-FLOW prototype 5/5 scores and hardcoded transitions are UX references only. Preserve historical T01–T10 APIs/tests; implement the new view version in new game-v1 modules instead of silently changing legacy five-mark boards or command parsers. Use black/charcoal/neutral-frost chrome and full-colour approved expressive content through semantic asset keys. Modal-first means the complete game background is uniformly blur/dim/desaturated and inert; the fixed platform banner dock remains mounted outside that game viewport. No visible accounts/login, telemetry, credentials, live Firebase, ad SDK or unreviewed asset downloads. Keep local presentation distinct from authority: clients display server/solo-engine phases and deadlines, never compute secret outcomes, choose timeout targets, advance multiplayer on a local clock or reveal another alignment. Use injected semantic media/ad/purchase ports; no direct SDK playback or billing calls from UI. Edit only ownership, use original fixtures, run scoped tests/lint/typecheck and npm run check. DOM tests use jsdom, explicit afterEach(cleanup), Vitest and current Testing Library. Report results and contract changes; do not commit, push, open PRs, deploy or spend on providers. Implement UI integration bindings for the reviewed semantic Audio/Haptics, preference, AdsPort and PurchasePort interfaces. Every material UI action emits the proper semantic event once without private payload; user gesture precedes web audio, Music/SFX/Haptics and Reduce Motion each govern their proper behavior. Consume the persistent dock/layout implementation from A089 and mount its stable instance at the application root with initial reserved adaptive height/safe area across menus, lobby, game, modal and cinematic; verified Remove Ads alone removes it. Match End exit may request a policy-approved interstitial but never waits for load/consent/failed ad. Web defaults no-op; no direct ad/audio/billing SDK, invented units or receipt trust. Prevent remount/reflow and keep ads outside blurred game overlay layers. HapticsPort is defined by A082 and defaults to its silent/no-op implementation. A084 native haptics is an optional supplied capability, never a prerequisite for this binding or offline Solo. Missing native app configuration must not prevent web/local navigation or essential visual/semantic feedback.
acceptance: Injected no-op/test ports demonstrate exactly-once semantic cues with no role, diagnostic, passcode, lobby code or decision payload sent to media/ads.
Dock instance stays mounted and reserves stable safe height across every screen, modal, City Moment and cinematic until verified entitlement removes it.
Music/SFX/Haptics/Reduce Motion and restore/purchase state changes apply independently without automatic audio or fake billing authority.
Only an approved post-match explicit exit reaches interstitial policy; unavailable/failing adapters never block navigation or live game input.
Offline Solo and web preview run with A082 silent HapticsPort when native A084 is unavailable; native configuration never becomes a transitive runtime prerequisite.
designSections: AUDIO-SPEC: Implementation contract; MONETIZATION-SPEC: Persistent banner dock, Interstitial frequency/safety, Swarm implementation contract
